scope: Complete semantic read of five previously omitted HBQ diagnostic/editor functions; compare intent, lifecycle and cost with current CBE. No runtime parity claim.

dispositions.intent: Owner-local FPS, scheduler wake delay, active scripts, driven vehicles and ray rate; optional server publication while a client renews demand.
dispositions.findings: Permanent scheduled worker sleeps one second even when disabled. Enabled sampling wakes every0.1s for two seconds; server demand expires after10s. Stats include controller milliseconds but formatted display omits that field. These samples cannot establish matched frame-time overhead or p95 performance budget.
dispositions.decision: Retain CBE existing bounded256 owner-local callback ring and on-demand nearest-rank duration/queue-latency summaries. Do not add permanent sleeping monitor, public namespace demand timestamp or hintSilent UI. Aggregate sensing/ray workload counters and authenticated opt-in remote owner diagnostics remain unimplemented; evaluate with actual profiling rather than calling callback time a frame-overhead result.

dispositions.intent: Per-object numbered messages, identical-text10s coalescing; viewers measure duration locally instead of comparing server/client clocks.
dispositions.findings: Public object list prunes nulls only when another message is issued; per-object sequence is not an ownership epoch. HBQAD_DbgLast is also used by driveAssistDebug for a different path/obstacle tuple, so the text throttle and geometry cache can overwrite each other on a machine running both.
dispositions.decision: Select clock-independent expiry and coalescing as diagnostic intent. Any CBE implementation needs separate typed keys, bounded retained objects, owner/episode provenance and explicit disable/deletion cleanup. Do not copy shared keys or global broadcast list.

dispositions.intent: Interface-only Draw3D overlay gated by enabled/debug and camera distance800m; draw above current visual object bounds.
dispositions.findings: Registration is idempotent by global EH sentinel, but the EH remains installed. Every enabled frame traverses full shared object list; per-client first visibility starts message duration even for old retained publications, including JIP.
dispositions.decision: Useful observer-local presentation intent only. New messages need bounded freshness in addition to local display duration; disable should release handlers and retained state. No tactical acceptance credit for rendered labels.

dispositions.intent: Render vehicle-relative obstacle/traffic rays, nav corridor direction, helper geometry and planned path/obstacle spheres.
dispositions.findings: Draw3D is setting gated; separate untracked sphere worker runs every0.25s without enabled/debug gate. Local sphere objects persist while vehicles remain in DebugVehs. Ground path spheres force ATL z0.6, losing bridge/grade route height. Nav outline uses terrain height, not selected corridor plane. Per-frame lists are uncapped.
dispositions.decision: Select read-only rays/current obstacle/route and corridor-direction visualisation intent. Do not port sphere objects or permanent worker. Diagnostic geometry must use actual accepted route/support coordinates and cannot become movement targets. Current CBE corridor pitch/support is implemented; equivalent HBQ observer visualisation remains a code gap, not required background simulation.

dispositions.intent: Editor-only live rectangle and travel arrow for every navigation-area module, following current size/rotation/movement.
dispositions.findings: Walks all Eden logics each Draw3D frame, ignores pitch in axis and projects corners onto terrain+0.6. No explicit EH removal path in this function.
dispositions.decision: Select meaningful corridor preview as editor usability work. CBE task currently registers runtime corridor and pitch validation; do not claim custom preview parity from module registration. A future preview must follow selected corridor plane and distinguish proposal from accepted safe route, with bounded module cache/refresh and editor lifecycle cleanup.

validation: All five complete function bodies read. Source hashes recorded against untouched complete private snapshot. CBE scheduler and diagnostic consumers inspected. Local HBQ exact-membership/hash index regenerated and checked. Engineering-only review: no runtime changes, new tests, redundant build or audit.
remaining: XEH_preInit settings/config semantic review and full controller branch reconciliation remain. Five reviewed functions do not prove whole-HBQ parity. Runtime tactical behaviour and5percent median/10percent p95 overhead unverified; audits PAUSED.
